scan.title: Find your board
scan.instructions: Turn the board on. The blue LED blinks slowly.

noBoards.title: We could not find any board
noBoards.instructions: Check that the board is on and close to your phone.
noBoards.tip: If the LED stays on, hold the BOOT button on the board for 5 seconds and try again.

wifi.title: Connect the board to Wi-Fi
wifi.hint24: Use a 2.4 GHz network. The board does not work with 5 GHz networks.
wifi.privacy: We do not save your Wi-Fi name or password.

progress.connectingHint: It can take about 20 seconds. Keep the app open and stay close to the board.

success.title: Board connected
success.hint: Your board is now linked to this field and will start sending data.
success.alreadyLinked: This board was already linked to this field.

wifi.title: Could not connect to Wi-Fi
wifi.hint: Check the Wi-Fi name and the password. Remember that the board only works with 2.4 GHz networks.

timeout.title: Time ran out
timeout.hint: Move the board closer to the router and your phone, and try again.

noInternet.title: Wi-Fi connected, but no internet
noInternet.hint: Check the internet connection of your router and try again.

bluetoothOff.title: Bluetooth is off
bluetoothOff.hint: Turn on Bluetooth on your phone and try again.

permission.title: Bluetooth permission is missing
permission.hint: Allow AgriTwin to use Bluetooth in your phone settings and try again.

link.title: Could not talk to the board
link.hint: Move closer to the board, check that the LED blinks slowly and try again.

alreadyRegistered.title: This board is already in another field
alreadyRegistered.hint: A board can only be linked to one field. Remove it from the other field before adding it here.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has expired
sessionExpired.hint: Log in again and add the board again.

saveFailed.title: Board connected, but not saved
saveFailed.hint: The board connected to Wi-Fi, but we could not save it. Try again.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.hint: Try again. If it keeps failing, restart the board.

web.title: Only available on your phone
web.hint: To add a board you need the AgriTwin app on your phone, because it uses Bluetooth.
